programme.title: Golden City
programme.desc: This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: King of Culinary: Woks Up

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: Talk of The Town
programme.desc: A half-hour talk-show segment in Hello Singapore which brings together diverse voices and expert opinions to thought-provoking discussions on wide range of issues. Incorporating online polls which gather public opinions, the segment creates a space that allows for multi viewpoints in the studio from Monday to Friday.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

programme.title: Sleep Right, Sleep Tight
programme.desc: This programme subverts everyone's imagination of the world of sleep. Are there any scientific basis for counting sheeps? Invited guests will aprticipate in a sleeping test. Everyone can sleep, but not everyone can sleep well. If you want to sleep well, one must know what to do before going to bed.

programme.title: Golden City
programme.desc: This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

Can the team transform the kitchen into a warm space where mother and son can truly feel at home?

programme.title: The Glory
programme.desc: Abandoned as a child, Zhuang Han Yan grows up in the southern countryside before returning to her family in the capital. She catches the eye of Fu Yun Xi, a deputy minister with a mysterious illness, who sees her as an ideal wife. As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: Lost You Forever
programme.desc: Cang Xuan managed to overcome the suppression and schemes of his fifth and seventh uncles and successfully ascended to the throne of the Western Yan Kingdom. In order to help Cang Xuan with his grand ambitions, Xiao Yao planned to rely on the unity of the Central Plains clans to assist Cang Xuan, and arranged a marriage alliance with Chi Shui Feng Long.

programme.title: With Love, Becks
programme.desc: While bride-to-be Rebecca prepares to step into the new phase of her life, she will be meeting up with a married female guest in each episode to enjoy a girls' day out and engage in heart-to-heart talks about love, life, and everything in between. She will also uncover the secrets to the successful marriage of the guest. “女神”林慧玲在举行婚礼前，以准人妻身份，向已婚的女红星、杰出女政要、女网红取经讨教，深入了解她们维持幸福婚姻的诀窍、夫妻相处之道，以及认识传统的婚礼习俗。每集节目，林慧玲将相约一位女嘉宾共同进行活动，过程中彼此也会畅聊、分享女生之间的悄悄话。希望透过女嘉宾们无私的分享与关照，让她从此幸福玲距离。

programme.title: Foodie Trio
programme.desc: Do youngsters like traditional cuisine? Are the older generation resistant to trendy dishes? Do kids only eat fast food? To dispel these misconceptions, 3 hosts from different age groups will go on a nationwide culinary journey in a van, bringing them closer through food. An ingredient each episode, guiding viewers to explore a variety of traditional food, creative dishes, and kid-friendly treats!新一代年轻人不爱吃传统美食？老一辈年长者无法接受潮流料理？小孩只爱汉堡薯条？为了打破迷思，三位不同年龄层的主持人，将乘坐古董面包车，走访全国寻找美味料理，让美食打破年龄的隔阂，拉近彼此距离！每集将围绕一个主食材，带领大家探索各种不同的传统佳肴、创意料理和童趣美食，三道菜肴都各具特色，势必直击大家的味蕾！

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: The owner of My One and Only, Ma Limin, aspires to become a real estate developer with her son Hao Renpin, offering one-stop services for property purchase and renovation with her husband Hao Haojian and interior designer Wan Defu, who run How Luck Renovation. Their interactions with their clients reveal stories about different types of families. 马丽敏是“只此一家”的老板娘，怀抱着做发展商的目标，带着儿子郝仁品在地产界闯荡。丈夫郝健和室内设计师万德福负责“好运装修公司”，一家人一起包办客户房屋买卖和装修的需要。透过他们所接待的客户，看到形形色色和“家”有关的故事…

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: Every Body Knows
programme.desc: Cancer is widely feared, but how does it develop, and how do cancer cells evade the immune system? How can Immunotherapy reactivate the body’s defences to fight cancer? This episode explores this new approach to cancer treatment—Immunotherapy.

programme.title: Frontline
programme.desc: Why do some pedestrians risk their lives by jaywalking despite nearby traffic lights and overhead bridges? A Traffic Police enforcement operation sheds light on how road design and human behaviour contribute to risky crossings. Plus, Yishun residents complain about constant weekend noise from a nearby school's football and basketball courts. Some even leave their homes to escape the noise.

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: Chasing Lava
programme.desc: Chasing Lava is an epic journey into the world's most spectacular and dangerous volcanoes and the extraordinary people who cannot resist their call. Filmed across three continents, five countries and nine active volcanoes, this breathtaking two-part documentary follows fearless adventurers who venture into the fiery heart of erupting craters and pioneering scientists racing to decipher the warning signs of disaster. From the explosive volcanoes of Vanuatu and Indonesia to Iceland's dramatic landscapes of fire and ice, Ethiopia's otherworldly volcanic wilderness and the restless volcanoes of the Philippines, the series takes viewers to some of Earth's most hostile and awe-inspiring places. Combining spectacular cinematography with intimate human stories, Chasing Lava is a thrilling exploration of courage, obsession, discovery and humanity's enduring fascination with the powerful forces that shape our restless planet.

programme.title: Call Us Wunderkind
programme.desc: What if your child could do what most adults never will? Call Us Wunderkind follows child prodigies across Singapore, Thailand and the Philippines, and the families who have rebuilt their lives around them. But who decides a child is a prodigy? And what does it take to keep one going? Across six episodes, the series counts the time, money and attention poured into a single gift, and asks who really pays. What happens when a child who never fails, does? Where does a prodigy go to just be a kid? When a talent goes viral, who controls the story? And when the applause dies down, who are they without it? With insights from gifted-education experts, psychologists and former prodigies, Call Us Wunderkind takes an intimate look at childhoods lived at full speed, and asks what it really means to grow up extraordinary.

programme.title: Drugs 2.0
programme.desc: The global drug landscape is being reshaped by the fast-moving challenge of new psychoactive substances (NPS) –compounds engineered to replicate the highs of drugs like MDMA, heroin and cannabis. They are constantly evolving and far more unpredictable. Created by modifying the chemical structure of traditional illicit drugs to circumvent drug laws, they can evade routine drug tests, leaving global drug regulators racing to respond. In Singapore, these mostly synthetic drugs remain a small but growing threat. New laws now cover any substance that can produce a psychoactive effect. But as younger users are drawn in by the illusion of safer highs, authorities warn the problem could escalate if left unchecked. CNA follows the trail from clandestine labs in India to Singapore’s forensic labs, where scientists scramble to decode the ever-changing chemistry behind these drugs.

Created by modifying the chemical structure of traditional illicit drugs to circumvent drug laws, they can evade routine drug tests, leaving global drug regulators racing to respond. In Singapore, these mostly synthetic drugs remain a small but growing threat. New laws now cover any substance that can produce a psychoactive effect. But as younger users are drawn in by the illusion of safer highs, authorities warn the problem could escalate if left unchecked. CNA follows the trail from clandestine labs in India to Singapore’s forensic labs, where scientists scramble to decode the ever-changing chemistry behind these drugs.

programme.title: Chasing Lava
programme.desc: Chasing Lava is an epic journey into the world's most spectacular and dangerous volcanoes and the extraordinary people who cannot resist their call. Filmed across three continents, five countries and nine active volcanoes, this breathtaking two-part documentary follows fearless adventurers who venture into the fiery heart of erupting craters and pioneering scientists racing to decipher the warning signs of disaster. From the explosive volcanoes of Vanuatu and Indonesia to Iceland's dramatic landscapes of fire and ice, Ethiopia's otherworldly volcanic wilderness and the restless volcanoes of the Philippines, the series takes viewers to some of Earth's most hostile and awe-inspiring places. Combining spectacular cinematography with intimate human stories, Chasing Lava is a thrilling exploration of courage, obsession, discovery and humanity's enduring fascination with the powerful forces that shape our restless planet.
